verdict.rationale: Bruno's homepage claims it can 'serve realistic mock responses while you build,' suggesting some mocking capability, but there is no documentation detail on generating a mock server from saved examples or an API spec, no CLI/mock-server command evidence, and no independent corroboration of this feature working. missing for 10: detailed docs on mock server setup from saved requests/spec, evidence of mocking from OpenAPI spec, hands-on/community validation of the mock feature.
